title: RetransmitIter::next has potential underflow if pos < start
description: Line 1099: `let rel_pos = abs_pos - self.start;` - If self.pos < self.start (possible since struct has pub fields and no constructor), this subtraction underflows. Currently low-risk because struct is unused (see .1). If retained, invariant start <= pos must be enforced via constructor, or start/pos should be private. Related to finding .1 (dead code).
